summary.question: What minimal dense embedding scale and which specific dense modes (citation heritage, section cross-lingual, linear hybrid complement) are necessary and sufficient for the product's non-jurist-preference views?

citation_heritage.finding: 12k ACCEPTED dense embeddings (2000-2002) have only 2 positive citation pairs - insufficient for AUC computation. Prior accepted evidence (factory_direction v34) shows citation heritage AUC 0.79-0.85 at 144k/174k scale, beating TF-IDF (0.71-0.74). Requires 144k+ scale for meaningful evaluation.
citation_heritage.blocker: Sparse citation graph at 12k; BGE/bger ID mapping + parquet 2022-2026 needed for 174k dense

cross_lingual_full_text_dense.finding: Full-text dense embeddings show cross_lang_same_branch 0.95-1.0 at scales >=2000, but separation is negative (cross-lang > same-lang) at mid-scales. Adversarial benchmark confirms language_dominance_mean=0.9895. High cross-lingual scores are artifacts of language confounding, not legal alignment.
cross_lingual_full_text_dense.minimal_scale: N/A - metric invalid due to language dominance
cross_lingual_full_text_dense.note: Section-segmented dense embeddings (sachverhalt > dispositiv > erwaegungen) would be needed per accepted evidence, but blocked by corpus lane data blockers

linear_hybrid_concat.finding: Linear hybrid (concat) works at 3839 scale (max aligned TF-IDF/dense overlap). All weights w=0.3-0.7 achieve jurist_proxy (legal_neighbor_rate) > 0.99, far exceeding 0.60 threshold. Cross-lingual alignment improves with dense weight (w=0.7: CL=0.942). Legal area purity/NMI also improve with dense weight.
linear_hybrid_concat.optimal_weight_range: w=0.3-0.7 for cross-lingual; w=0.5-0.7 for legal area clustering
linear_hybrid_concat.note: Jurist proxy is inflated by language dominance; true OOS jurist preference ceiling ~0.53 per factory direction

baselines.dense_only: High branch k-NN (>0.99) and cross-lingual (inflated), but legal_area purity declines with scale (0.61->0.48)
baselines.tfidf_only: Moderate cross-lingual (~0.85) with positive separation, lower legal_area purity (~0.33-0.44)

data_blockers: BGE/bger ID mapping required to align 174k dense embeddings with evaluation metadata
Parquet 2022-2026 missing (29,520 decisions) - cannot compute 174k dense embeddings
Section extraction (sachverhalt/erwaegungen/dispositiv) at 174k scale needed for section cross-lingual view
accepted_negative_findings_confirmed: True OOS jurist preference ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target (dense cannot be primary navigation)
v18 coarse hierarchy NEGATIVE (max branch purity 0.65 < 0.7)
Citation heritage recall@10 NEGATIVE (max 0.0066) - citation heritage is ranking signal, not retrieval
Boilerplate resistance: dense embeddings more susceptible
